jobs.occupation: (Junior) Inside Sales | German Market | Antwerp | On-site
jobs.description:
As an junior inside Sales Representative, you will take ownership of the German market, developing new business opportunities and building long-term customer relationships. You will join a dynamic, international family-owned company in the food industry, where initiative, commercial drive and results are highly valued.

Bedrijfsomschrijving

Our client is a well-established international company operating within the food sector. With a family-business mindset, entrepreneurial spirit, and strong growth ambitions, they offer a fast-paced environment where initiative and results are highly valued.

Omschrijving

• Proactively identify and develop new business opportunities within the German market.
• Build and maintain long-term relationships with customers and prospects.
• Manage the full sales cycle, from lead generation to closing deals.
• Conduct commercial negotiations and follow up on sales opportunities.
• Expand the customer portfolio and strengthen market presence.
• Analyze sales performance and market trends.
• Report on sales activities and contribute to the overall sales strategy.

• Fluent in German and English, knowledge of Dutch or additional languages is a strong asset.
• Previous experience in sales, business development, or a commercial role is a plus, but junior candidates with the right mindset are also welcome.
• Strong commercial acumen and a results-oriented mindset.
• A true go-getter with the drive to open new doors and create opportunities.
• Confident communicator with excellent relationship-building skills.
• Self-motivated, proactive, and eager to learn.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
• Affinity with the food industry is an advantage.
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience is a plus.

jobs.occupation: Customer Service & Customs Coordinator | West-Flanders Area
jobs.description:
Our client is a long-established industrial manufacturer with production sites in Belgium and abroad, supplying high-performance chemical solutions. Supported by private equity investors, the organisation is evolving from a traditional setup towards a more modern, performance-driven operating model. The company is located in the North of the province of West Flanders.

Jobomschrijving

The Customer Service & Customs Coordinator will:

• Become a key member of a team of five customer service professionals, managing the complete order-to-cash process for an international B2B customer portfolio.
• Oversee and manage customs documentation and trade compliance activities for international import and export transactions.
• Act as the primary point of contact for customers, building strong relationships and ensuring an excellent service experience from order placement through delivery and invoicing.
• Proactively manage customer enquiries, orders, delivery follow-up, and issue resolution, ensuring customer satisfaction and operational excellence.
• Coordinate closely with planning, logistics, production, and sales teams to ensure seamless execution of customer commitments.
• Collaborate with freight forwarders and customs brokers to facilitate smooth and compliant cross-border shipments.
• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and digital transformation projects, helping modernise processes and enhance customer service efficiency.

The Customer Service & Customs Coordinator we are looking for has:

• At least 3 years of experience in customer service, order management, logistics coordination and/or customs within an international B2B environment.
• A genuine customer-centric mindset and the ability to build strong relationships with both customers and internal stakeholders.
• Experience working with ERP systems (SAP is a strong asset).
• Knowledge of customs processes and international trade compliance requirements.
• Strong organisational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
• Fluency in Dutch and English; French and/or German are considered an advantage.
• The flexibility and adaptability to thrive in a changing environment and support process improvements.

Do you also love fries and are looking for a new challenge? Our client is a leading player in the production and development of potato-based delicacies. Due to further growth of the Wielsbeke site, we are looking for a Malfunction Technician curative maintenance in 2 shifts. As a technician, you are the key to quickly and efficiently solving technical malfunctions on our fully automated machinery. Your goal? Ensure smooth operation and minimise downtime.
 
 
 
• Be an example in adhering to prescribed guidelines and procedures for a safe, environmentally conscious, and orderly working environment. 
 
• Dive deep into mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems to diagnose and resolve faults. 
 
• Perform repairs and replace defective parts to keep our machines in top condition. 
 
• Work closely with our operations teams and your technical colleagues to minimise breakdowns and maximise efficiency. 
 
• Keep fault reports in our maintenance software (Ultimo) to gain insight and keep improving. 
 
• Share your expertise and advise on possible improvements to prevent repeat breakdowns. 
 
• You will mentor new employees to help them grow in their roles 
 
• You will work in our Maintenance department, reporting to your Technical Team Leader. 

 
 
• You have a technical education or equivalent experience 
 
• You have several years of experience as a technician and a passion for technology 
 
• You have knowledge of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic and pneumatic systems 
 
• You have a proactive attitude 
 
• You have logical insight and good problem-solving skills, allowing you to work independently 
 
• You are a team player who contributes to smooth communication and joint success 
 
• You speak Dutch or French or English and are willing to understand other language colleagues 
 
• You are willing to work in a 2-shift regime

Our client is a leading player in the event industry, specialized in the design and production of exhibition stand systems. The company is known for its innovative approach and high-quality products that are used worldwide at trade fairs, exhibitions, and events.

Are you experienced in operating sawing machines and working with aluminium profiles? As a Saw Operator, you will cut aluminium profiles according to technical drawings and ensure that every piece meets the required quality standards.

You will work in a modern production environment in Roeselare, alternating between series production, one-off production and special pieces. You will work in a 2-shift system and use an ERP system to process production orders.

Your main tasks include:

 
• 
Reading technical drawings and determining how the pieces need to be cut.

 
• 
Setting up the sawing machine, including the required lengths and cutting angles.

 
• 
Cutting aluminium profiles for series production, one-off production and special pieces.

 
• 
Checking your own work using gauges and measuring tools such as a tape measure and caliper.

 
• 
Recording quality checks on inspection sheets.

 
• 
Processing production orders in the ERP system Business Central – Propos.

 
• 
Communicating relevant information during shift handovers.

 
• 
Carrying out first-line maintenance, such as cleaning the machine and replacing saw blades.

 
• 
Supporting other workstations when necessary.

You have experience as a Operator.

You can read technical drawings related to sawing and cutting components.

 
• 
You can work with measuring tools such as a tape measure and caliper.

• 
Basic knowledge of Dutch, both spoken and written, is an advantage.

 
• 
Working in a 2-shift system suits you.

 
• 
You work accurately and check the quality of your own work.

 
• 
You keep your workplace clean and organised.

 
• 
Experience with an ERP system is an advantage.

Chef De Partie : Tandoor & bbq chef

Then this might be your new challenge!

You will be working for a rapidly growing logistics company that distributes frozen products.

As an Order Picker, you are an indispensable link in the logistics process. You ensure that orders are prepared and shipped without errors.

- You collect frozen products using a pick list and scanner.
- You stack boxes correctly on pallets according to the instructions.
- You prepare orders for shipment and place pallets in the right place.
- You work with an electric pallet truck.

You have experience as an order picker or logistics employee.
You are familiar with working with an electric pallet truck.
You can work in a cold environment of -22°C without any problems
You enjoy active work.
You work accurately, are reliable, and think in terms of the team.

- Attesten:
Certificate for electric pallet truck is a plus, but not mandatory.

- Opleidingsvereisten:
No diploma required.

- Talenkennis:
Good knowledge of English

As a packer at BNFW, you play an essential role in the process of preparing our products for shipment. 

You will work according to BNFW's quality standards to ensure that only the best products leave the facility.

Responsibilities:

• Carefully and efficiently packing fruit products according to guidelines.

• Checking the quality of the fruit and separating products that do not meet the standards.

• Ensuring the correct labeling and packaging of the products.

• Complying with hygiene and safety regulations in the workplace.

• Contributing to a clean and organized work environment.

What do we ask of you?

• An eye for detail and accuracy when performing tasks

• Physically capable of performing repetitive tasks and working in a standing position

• Willingness to work in a refrigerated environment

• Good knowledge of English

You are available to work in at least two of the following shifts:

• From 6u to 13u45

• From 8u to 15u45

• From 14u to 21u45

Antwerp Convention Bureau (ACB – www.antwerpconventionbureau.be) focuses on promoting the city of Antwerp as a premium destination for meetings, incentives, conferences, exhibitions, and events (MICE). Their brand promise is ‘The city is your venue’. Antwerp Convention Bureau highlights the diverse range of conference facilities in Antwerp and builds strong local expertise to support conference organizers and attendees in hosting conferences and business activities within the city.
The goal is to use a comprehensive marketing strategy and a proactive approach to attract international B-2-B events for associations or the industry that generate a positive impact on the residents, entrepreneurs, and visitors of the city of Antwerp. These events reinforce local and regional policies because they are linked to strong economic clusters, knowledge institutions, or centers of expertise.
In order to expand its organization and network, Antwerp Convention Bureau is actively seeking a new Managing Director.

Jobomschrijving

As Managing Director, you are the driving force behind the long-term strategy and financial performance of the organisation. Taking full P&L responsibility, you safeguard the financial health and ensure a maximum return on investment for the allocated budgets. You build on the current momentum by prioritizing the structuring of the organisation, implementing clear processes, and inspiring the internal team. Furthermore, you act as the primary local and international ambassador who proudly carries the bureau's successes to the city and its stakeholders, further shaping its vision within the meeting and convention (MICE) industry. 
As Managing Director, you will be responsible for:

• Managing human and financial resources efficiently within the allocated budgets while meeting the city's KPI’s.
• Coaching, motivating, and guiding the team to perform at their maximum potential, ensuring clear roles and responsibilities.
• Maintaining a strong and proactive network of relationships with the financing government, local stakeholders, and various players within the industry.
• Reporting on operations and milestones to the Executive Board.
• Representing ACB with strong communication skills. Expanding the (inter)national network within the highly competitive meeting industry. Simultaneously, you showcase local successes and act as the public face of the organization fostering the local public relations (PR), translating achievements into pride for the city and local stakeholders. 
• Leading the day-to-day management and further development of the organisation in line with the long-term strategy, ensuring the implementation of clear procedures, best practices, and an optimal organisational structure.

You are first and foremost an organisation builder and a true people manager who provides your team with direction, clarity, and structure. Additionally, you are a business-minded networker who effortlessly represents the organisation and inspires others during presentations and networking events. You possess a strategic approach paired with innovative thinking, and you show great diplomatic sensitivity towards the interests of local stakeholders.
Additionally, you possess:

• A Master’s degree (or equivalent working and thinking level), coupled with substantial experience in setting up, structuring, and leading a solid organisation at a senior management level.
• Strong PR skills and a proven track record of local stakeholder management, successfully communicating results to government, partners, ambassadors, the team and other stakeholders.
• A background in the (inter)national hospitality industry, or experience as a senior business marketing and sales professional within a highly competitive international sector. Experience within the MICE sector is considered a strong asset, though leadership skills are prioritized.
• A strict commitment to being based in Antwerp alongside a readiness to travel internationally.
• Excellent oral and written communication skills in both Dutch and English.

We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated individual to join our accounting team. As an 
Accounts Payable Specialist, you will play a crucial role in the creation and execution of our Accounts Payable 2.0 processes, transitioning from manual invoice processing to automated workflows, with a focus on KPI reporting, efficiency enhancement, and transparency. The ideal candidate will have excellent analytical skills, advanced proficiency in Excel and SAP.
 

This role will address existing challenges, establish robust processes, and ensure the accurate and timely processing of all AP flows.
 

Responsibilities
 
 

• Test and implement new or updated vendor invoice management systems. 

• Develop and implement effective processes and KPIs to streamline and monitor manual tasks. 

• Implement critical checkpoints for automatically posted invoices to ensure accuracy and efficiency. 

• Collaborate with Logistics and Purchasing teams to identify opportunities for improvement and increase the number of automatically processed invoices. 

• Create and maintain full Procure-to-Pay (P2P) reporting using advanced Excel and SAP knowledge. 

• Provide guidance and training to the accounting team to bridge knowledge gaps and improve overall team efficiency. 

• Foster transparency in operational processes, vendor balances, and dispute resolutions.  

 

 

• Proven experience in accounts payable or a similar accounting role with a focus on process improvement. 

• Advanced proficiency in Excel and intermediate SAP knowledge. 

• Strong communication skills in English. 

• Analytical skills to design and implement checks for automation in the P2P process. 

• Ability to lead and collaborate with cross-functional and international teams. 

• Detail-oriented, with strong organizational and time management skills. 

• Ability to adapt to a dynamic work environment and drive positive change.

BMSvision is not just another tech company; they are your go-to partner for Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) in the discrete manufacturing industry, with a specific focus on the textile, plastics and packaging industries. Their highly skilled R&D experts are passionate about developing top-notch hardware and software solutions that register productivity, quality and energy consumption data. This empowers their customers to fine-tune their operations for optimal efficiency.

Established in 2008 as a spin-off by Barco and currently part of the Vandewiele group, the BMSvision team has gained substantial experience learning from a large installed base in the plastics and textile industry. Their MES-solutions seamlessly integrate with ERP systems, addressing the requirements of Industry 4.0 and the broader Smart Factory landscape.

They’ve established their presence in Belgium (HQ), the UK, the US, China, India, Malaysia and Turkey. Additionally, they’ve built a worldwide network of agents and service centers.

Jobomschrijving

Drive international growth by helping manufacturers succeed in their Industry 4.0 journey

• You will be responsible for selling MES-systems to B2B customers in the global growth markets of textiles and plastics.
• You focus on medium and large enterprises and you'll speak to strategic decision makers (owners, general management, IT and production management).
• In the countries where you operate, you will work together with sales agents. You research the market potential of your countries, select quality partners with a good reputation, evaluate their activities and visit prospects whose doors they will open.
• You are responsible for preparing offers, launching marketing campaigns and making presentations.
• You participate in national and international fairs.
• You think along with the customer and convince them that BMS is their suitable partner for their Industry 4.0 strategy.

• You hold a technical or technical/economic master’s degree or you've built up equivalent expertise through experience and you have a strong affinity with software-driven solutions.
• Ideally, you bring around 10 years of experience in Sales or Business Development, preferably within the manufacturing industry, where you have successfully positioned business operations or MES-related software.
• You feel at ease collaborating with stakeholders at different levels and you have a proven track record in complex, project-driven sales environments with longer sales cycles.
• You love to travel internationally frequently and you are interested in other cultures.
• You communicate fluently in English and any additional language skills, such as French, German, Italian, etc., are a strong asset.
• Continuous learning energizes you. You enjoy negotiating, building long-term relationships and taking ownership.
• You combine an entrepreneurial mindset with strong self-management skills, all within a collaborative corporate culture where pragmatism, intrapreneurship and responsibility truly matter.

Our client, located in the Beveren region, is looking for a Supervisor Piping & Mechanical with strong technical expertise and people leadership skills.
 
 

• You’ll lead, coordinate and supervise daily piping and mechanical maintenance activities with a strong focus on HSE, quality, cost control and operational continuity 

• You’ll plan, prioritize and allocate maintenance work to ensure efficient execution of both preventive and corrective maintenance activities 

• You’ll organize daily toolbox meetings, communicate priorities and ensure compliance with all safety procedures and permit-to-work requirements 

• You’ll actively supervise field activities and provide technical support to technicians and contractors during the execution of maintenance work 

• You’ll coordinate closely with Operations, Engineering, Reliability and Inspection departments to align maintenance priorities and ensure efficient plant availability 

• You’ll ensure the safe and efficient execution of maintenance activities on piping systems, pressure vessels, heat exchangers, storage tanks and other static equipment 

• You’ll safeguard the mechanical integrity of plant assets by ensuring that maintenance and repair activities are executed according to engineering standards, site procedures and applicable regulations 

• You’ll support inspection programs and follow up on findings, integrity assessments, statutory inspections and corrective actions 

• You’ll coordinate and manage external contractors, ensuring compliance with safety, quality, planning and budget requirements 

• You’ll monitor work quality and verify that repairs, modifications and installations are completed according to specifications and industry standards 

• You’ll support the preparation, execution and evaluation of shutdowns, turnarounds and maintenance projects 

• You’ll drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on reliability, safety, efficiency and maintenance performance 

• You’ll ensure accurate maintenance administration and reporting in SAP, including work order completion, time registration and maintenance history 
 

• You have a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a comparable technical qualification, or equivalent by experience 

• You have at least 5 years of relevant maintenance experience within the petrochemical, chemical, oil & gas or related process industry 

• You’re experienced in a supervisory, team leader or coordination role within an industrial environment 

• You have solid knowledge of piping systems, pressure equipment, heat exchangers, storage tanks and other static equipment 

• You have a good understanding of mechanical integrity principles, inspection methodologies and reliability-driven maintenance practices 

• You have a strong knowledge of HSE requirements, permit-to-work systems, contractor management and process safety 

• You’re experienced with SAP or another CMMS system and good proficiency in Microsoft Office applications 

• You own strong planning, organizational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to effectively manage changing priorities 

• You have excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, enabling effective collaboration across multiple disciplines 

• You are fluent in Dutch and have a good command of English 

• You have a hands-on leadership style with the ability to motivate, coach and develop people

Wanzl has successfully evolved into a 
total solutions provider optimizing customer experiences.
 

To support the ambitious course in Belgium and Luxembourg, Wanzl is looking for an entrepreunerial Business Development Manager.  This role is pivotal in driving the new era, turning premium product innovations and digital solutions into sustainable market share.
 

As Business Development Manager, you act as 'co-architect' of the business transformation in BeLux, supporting the General Manager. You combine traditional sales with high-level strategic business development to gain market share with new, digital, and automated solutions. You pioneer new growth areas while further expanding existing strategic partnerships.
